increment_paragraph: **RK-TOPIC-PARTITION-LIST-CONSTRUCTORS** (USER DECISION 2026-11-21: launch the card the ledger entry specifies; no Rust, rule or Lean change; [report](../../reports/rk-topic-partition-list-constructors/README.md)). A new module `librdkafka/topic_partition_constructors.qv`, pinned at 66910c10 and 046accf6 (bodies byte-identical), declares `rd_kafka_topic_partition_list_new`, `_list_copy`, `rd_kafka_topic_partition_copy` and `rd_kafka_topic_partition_new` owned and nonnull (`rd_calloc` asserts), every formal borrowed, and `rd_kafka_topic_partition_destroy` released (nonnull, naming `rk_plugin_callback_closure`). The reference half is decided as encapsulation: the toppar references the copies take live in the result's own elements and its destructor drops them, so the caller owes only the result's release. `rd_kafka_topic_partition_new` and `_destroy` validate against their bodies; the other three are trusted assumptions. `rd_kafka_topic_partition_list_add` stays undeclared (its element pointer is invalidated by the next add's realloc). Opt-in `current --monkey-linked` over Fluent Bit 046accf6, one binary `ff817b5c` on trees 8e7e8d509 and e03c4835f: 1,159/2/3,636/7 -> 1,161/2/3,632/9. +2 Unknown -> Safe (`rd_kafka_topic_partition_copy_void`, `rd_kafka_topic_partition_list_copy_opaque`, the two predicted), 0 Safe -> non-Safe, +2 provisional Unsafe: `ut_testSameSubscriptions` (a unit test's assertion-failure returns leave `subscription` unreleased) and `rd_kafka_mock_handle_Metadata` (spurious on reading: a NULL-initialised, conditionally built list released under `if (p)` is a nullable resource at the nonnull release, which is refused, leaving a leak verdict). The 83 uncontracted leaves of the five functions in 68 rows become custody leaves (guarded nullable releases 20, member stores 9, member releases 4, out-parameter deliveries 4, ...). Round 4's four constructor-into-member rows stay Unknown on the access gate. Landed as integrate/r57 on main 1f2007667, after NULLABLE-GUARDED-RELEASE (r56): that card's private merged measurement of this branch gives 1,171/2/3,622/9 -> 1,171/2/3,623/8 with `rd_kafka_mock_handle_Metadata` Unsafe -> Unknown, so on main this card adds +2 Safe and one provisional Unsafe (`ut_testSameSubscriptions`); NULLABLE-GUARDED-RELEASE-REPORTED-AS-LEAK is not registered (discharged in part by r56, its remaining rows tracked by NULLABLE-LAZY-CONSTRUCTOR-IN-LOOP). The integrator rewrote `rd_kafka_topic_partition_destroy`'s string premise into the formula form SP5-GLOBAL-PROSE-PREMISE-BAN made mandatory (QF001), the text every other librdkafka declaration carries, and re-pinned it at both revisions (contract digest only; identities unchanged).

ledger.why: Declared and measured by RK-TOPIC-PARTITION-LIST-CONSTRUCTORS: rd_kafka_topic_partition_list_new, _list_copy, rd_kafka_topic_partition_copy (and rd_kafka_topic_partition_new) owned nonnull, rd_kafka_topic_partition_destroy released, pinned at 66910c10 and 046accf6; the reference-count half decided as encapsulation (the copies' toppar references are held by the result and dropped by its destructor); every caller's move reported on the opt-in route (1,159/2/3,636/7 -> 1,161/2/3,632/9: +2 Safe, 0 Safe lost, +2 provisional Unsafe, each explained). Residuals registered: RK-TOPIC-PARTITION-CONSTRUCTORS-UNVALIDATED, RK-TOPIC-PARTITION-LIST-ADD-ELEMENT-POINTER, OWNED-CONSTRUCTOR-OUT-PARAMETER-DELIVERY. The card's report also named NULLABLE-GUARDED-RELEASE-REPORTED-AS-LEAK; the integrator did not register it (integrate/r57): NULLABLE-GUARDED-RELEASE (integrate/r56, rule 74c) discharged its rd_kafka_mock_handle_Metadata instance and its hold-the-row-Unknown half before this card landed, and its remaining rows (seven rows' 8 leaves and rd_kafka_mock_handle_ShareFetch's 3) are tracked by NULLABLE-LAZY-CONSTRUCTOR-IN-LOOP.

ledger.title: rd_kafka_topic_partition_list_new, _list_copy and rd_kafka_topic_partition_copy are declared owned but their bodies do not validate
ledger.text: RK-TOPIC-PARTITION-LIST-CONSTRUCTORS declared them resource_return_owned(nonnull) in librdkafka/topic_partition_constructors.qv (pinned at 66910c10 and 046accf6); rd_kafka_topic_partition_new and rd_kafka_topic_partition_destroy validate (W4, entry), these three do not in rdkafka_partition.c on the opt-in run: _list_new's row is Unknown on the uncontracted static rd_kafka_topic_partition_list_grow (rd_realloc of the list's own elems member), _list_copy's on an access leaf (_add_copy into dst's elements), rd_kafka_topic_partition_copy's on the uncontracted static rd_kafka_topic_partition_update (metadata copy and a toppar reference into dst's _private). Two Safe rows (rd_kafka_topic_partition_copy_void, rd_kafka_topic_partition_list_copy_opaque) rest on them. DISCHARGE: validate each body (a realloc into a fresh object's member, the element copy, the reference taken into the result) or record the refusal that keeps them declared.

ledger.title: rd_kafka_topic_partition_list_add returns a pointer into an array its next call may reallocate; no contract form states that borrow
ledger.text: RK-TOPIC-PARTITION-LIST-CONSTRUCTORS left rd_kafka_topic_partition_list_add (rdkafka_partition.c:3190-3196, through _add0 :3149-3188) undeclared: it returns &rktparlist->elems[cnt++], and _grow rd_reallocs elems on a later add, so resource_return_borrowed_from(rktparlist, ...) (valid until the list's release) would admit a use after the next add. It co-blocks 22 of the 68 opt-in rows that named the card's constructors uncontracted (alone with them: ut_topic_partitions, ut_create_topic_partition_lists). DISCHARGE: a contract form for a result borrowed from a container until its next mutation (or a reading that refuses an element pointer held across a mutating call), then the declaration, measured.

ledger.title: An owned constructor result stored through an out-parameter (`*out = ctor()`) is read as a discarded owned result
ledger.text: RK-TOPIC-PARTITION-LIST-CONSTRUCTORS: with rd_kafka_topic_partition_list_new declared owned, `*partitions = rd_kafka_topic_partition_list_new(0)` (rdkafka_subscription.c:337, rd_kafka_assignment; :365, rd_kafka_subscription) and two more rows (rd_kafka_handle_OffsetFetch, ut_create_topic_partition_lists) carry `discarded owned result of resource API` (unsupported, Unknown): the delivery to the caller through the out-parameter is not read. Related to CG10-OWNED-OUT-PARAMETER-MEMBER-SLOT (an allocating callee writing into a member slot). DISCHARGE: read an owned result stored through a formal pointer as a delivery to the caller (an out-parameter summary), or name the refusal; re-measure the four rows.
